source.stem:
The graph represents the motion of a train travelling between two stations.
0 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 Which statement about the train is correct?

options.text: Its acceleration takes a longer time than its deceleration.
It travels at constant speed for less than half of its journey time.
It travels 2000 m in the first 100 s.
It travels 10⁰⁰0 m at constant speed.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Both observers are correct: the same stationary ball is 5 m and 8 m from the same post.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A chosen point on the ground cannot be a reference point unless an object stands there.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The kilometre stone is the reference point.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Measure the court-line distances first, then choose the reference point.

intelligence.enrichment: When distance is stated with respect to a fixed object or point, that fixed object or point is the reference point; the stated distance describes position with respect to it. chosen reference point -> meaning of the stated position or distance The learner correctly applies this rule: When distance is stated with respect to a fixed object or point, that fixed object or point is the reference point; the stated distance describes position with respect to it. The reference point is the object being located, not the fixed point from which distance is measured.
